note: Realism 2e (#482): the written guide of the knowledge lookup (AutonomousChatLookup). 'topics' are the question types in the order they are read: the first whose 'when' matches is the question's subject (each pattern is a regular expression on the line lower-cased, typos folded, every mark but letters and digits made a space, with a space at each end). 'entries' are the guide's answers: an entry answers a question of its topic when every 'when' matches and no 'unless' does; 'realm' (alb, mid, hib) limits an entry to askers of that realm; 'lines' are said as a player types them ({capital}, {porter}, {border_keep}, {vault}, {smith}, {xp_loss_level}, {con_loss_level}, {relic_bonus} are filled in); 'source' says where the fact comes from. Game help, never lore: no entry may be used by a lore channel. Tests only until seen in a played log.
